worldGen.flavor1..flavor20.description: The 20 world-gen loading flavor lines, edited as one catalog (one line per entry). Lines fan out to worldGen.flavor1…flavor20 and export as those 20 real keys.
suggestions:
The mountains decide where to stand.
Rivers pick their way downhill.
The coastline is still deciding.
Weather learns the shape of the hills.
Roads find the easiest way through.
Somewhere, the first road forks.
The sea works out where the land ends.
Valleys fill with the morning fog.
A trade route wears into the dirt.
The map's edges are still wet.
Rain finds the low places first.
Forests crowd up to the water's edge.
Distant peaks catch the last light.
Borders are drawn, then argued over.
Marshes spread where the ground gives way.
The seasons sort themselves out.
Wind takes the long way around the peaks.
Old stone remembers being a mountain.
A range of hills settles in for good.
The land settles, the way land does.

Names are entered into the record.
Someone is keeping the ledger.
Debts are noted. Grudges, too.
Every road gets a name and a length.
The archive fills, shelf by shelf.
Old treaties are filed and forgotten.
A clerk somewhere balances the books.
Histories are written down, then disputed.
The border is measured to the foot.
Taxes are assessed. Nobody is pleased.
The map is signed and dated.
Every family keeps its own account.
A name is spelled three different ways.
The ink is still drying on the charter.
Someone counts the harvest, twice.
Titles change hands on paper first.
Records outlast the people who kept them.
The founding date is agreed on, roughly.
A census goes out. Most of it comes back.
The oldest law is the one nobody remembers.

A kettle comes to the boil somewhere.
Lanterns are lit against the evening.
The market sets out its stalls.
Bread proves in a hundred kitchens.
A tavern decides on its name.
Cats claim the warmest doorsteps.
The well remembers everyone who visits.
Gossip finds its way across the square.
A cart loses a wheel, as carts do.
Someone plants a tree they won't see grow.
The baker opens before the sun.
Rumors settle in for a long life.
Children learn the shortcuts first.
A shutter bangs in the night wind.
Coins wear smooth, hand to hand.
The inn keeps one lamp burning late.
Somebody is always the last to leave.
A song travels from one town to the next.
Chimneys agree which way the smoke goes.
The road out of town waits for no one.
worldGen.flavor1..flavor20.rationale: Three full drop-in catalogs (one per register) so Miklos can take a set, mix, or write against them; each is 20 lines to fill flavor1..flavor20 one-to-one.
worldGen.flavor1..flavor20.exampleHint: Each suggestion is one complete 20-line set — line 1 -> flavor1, line 20 -> flavor20. Sets: A landscape-forming, B records-and-ledgers, C small-and-ordinary. A and B are the most genre-safe (they show before tone is known); C is charming but cozy-fantasy-village-coded and can clash with a non-fantasy concept — borrow from C sparingly, or use it only once fantasy is the house default.
